The primary subject is a diver in the foreground on the right, wearing a black wetsuit, BCD, mask, and regulator, with bubbles rising from their gear. A secondary diver is visible on the left, slightly out of focus, also equipped with scuba gear. The background is blue water with some particulate matter.
